papers.title: Future precipitation extremes and urban flood risk assessment using a non-stationary and convection-permitting climate-hydrodynamic modeling framework
papers.abstractEn: Urban planners and engineers rely on historical climate data to design flood protection infrastructure that should withstand extreme flooding events with 1% annual exceedance probability. This study examines how hourly precipitation extremes change as temperatures rise and how this affects urban flooding, using a new temperature-conditional extreme precipitation scaling approach and a novel convection-permitting regional climate model ensemble for +2 °C and +3 °C global warming scenarios. Hydrodynamic modeling is then used to estimate how future precipitation extremes translate into flood risks in two pre-alpine communes in Germany. Results show that ignoring climate change may severely underestimate flood risks: under the +3 °C scenario, the number of buildings affected by the highest flood risk category (water level of 1 m and above) increases by 60%, with larger increases in flow intensity in the steeper commune. Recently planned or implemented infrastructure may be inadequate for the coming decades.
papers.abstractZh: 城市规划者通常依赖历史气候数据设计可抵御百年一遇洪水的设施。本研究采用新的温度条件化极端降水缩放方法与对流允许区域气候模式集合, 分析全球升温2°C与3°C情景下短历时极端降水的变化, 并用动力水文模型评估德国两个阿尔卑斯前山城镇的未来洪涝风险。结果表明忽视气候变化将严重低估风险: 升温3°C情景下最高风险等级(水深1米以上)受影响建筑增加60%, 地形更陡的城镇流速增幅更大, 近期规划的基础设施可能不足以应对未来数十年气候变化。
papers.value: 定量评估气候变化下短历时极端暴雨对城市洪涝风险的影响, 对暴雨强度设计标准与城市防洪方向备考有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Spatio-temporal evolution characteristics and driving factors of water erosion under microtopography
papers.abstractEn: Delta-DEM accurately quantifies topographic changes such as erosion and sedimentation, but previous studies of micro-topographic water erosion rely on DEMs lacking a temporal dimension and cannot capture erosion dynamics. Artificial rainfall experiments were therefore conducted on a 15-degree artificial digging (AD) loess slope, and M-delta-DEM was used to quantify erosion pattern indicators and identify the key influencing factors. Results show distinct erosion morphology and spatial patterns on tilled slopes: erosion evolves into a tree-like structure, with detachment and transportation primarily on the upper slope and lateral deposition on the lower slope. Increased rainfall intensity reduces erosion fragmentation, enhances patch connectivity and broadens the impact area. Topographic factors influence soil erosion more strongly than rainfall factors, with surface roughness (1.0-1.25), topographic index and surface relief being most important. Adjusting surface roughness and slope gradient at the edges of loess slopes can effectively mitigate soil erosion under agricultural measures, supporting the management and conservation of sloped farmland.
papers.abstractZh: 为量化微地形水蚀的时空演变过程, 在15度人工开挖黄土坡面开展人工降雨试验, 采用M-ΔDEM方法定量提取侵蚀形态指标并分析关键影响因素。结果表明: 耕作坡面侵蚀演化为树枝状结构, 上坡以剥蚀搬运为主, 下坡出现侧向沉积; 雨强增大降低侵蚀破碎度、增强斑块连通性并扩大影响范围; 地形因子(地表粗糙度、地形指数、地表起伏度)对土壤侵蚀的影响大于降雨因子, 其中地表粗糙度1.0-1.25区间最为关键。在坡缘调整地表粗糙度与坡度可有效减轻侵蚀, 为黄土坡耕地水土保持管理提供依据。
papers.value: 微地形侵蚀时空演变与地形因子驱动的定量研究, 直接服务坡耕地水土保持措施设计, 是水土保持方向备考的核心知识点。

papers.title: A probabilistic procedure to define multidimensional rainfall thresholds for territorial landslide warning models
papers.abstractEn: A procedure designed to develop probabilistic thresholds for rainfall-induced landslides adopting novel rainfall variables is proposed and tested in an area of the Campania region, southern Italy. The dataset comprises 180 rainfall-induced landslides in the period 2010-2020 from the FraneItalia catalogue and rainfall records from 22 regional rain gauges. The procedure first reconstructs rainfall events responsible and not responsible for landslides, then automatically derives a large number of rainfall variables with a time-series feature extraction tool and evaluates their significance in identifying landslide-triggering events. Adopting a Bayesian approach, the most significant variables are used to define a set of probabilistic thresholds in one, two and three dimensions, and the most effective thresholds are identified by standard performance indicators. Thresholds employing novel rainfall variables outperform those using conventional variables: the minimum distance from the perfect classification point is 0.230 versus 0.292. The results demonstrate that novel rainfall variables can improve territorial landslide warning models.
papers.abstractZh: 提出一种采用新型降雨变量构建降雨型滑坡概率阈值的方法, 并在意大利坎帕尼亚地区进行检验。数据集包含2010-2020年间180处降雨型滑坡(FraneItalia目录)及22个区域雨量站记录。方法首先重构致灾与非致灾降雨事件, 利用时间序列特征提取工具自动派生大量降雨变量并评估其识别触发事件的显著性, 再用贝叶斯方法定义一维、二维、三维概率阈值, 并以标准性能指标择优。结果表明新型降雨变量阈值性能优于常规变量(距完美分类点的最小距离0.230对0.292), 可显著提升区域性滑坡预警模型的精度。
papers.value: 降雨型滑坡概率阈值与区域预警模型的方法前沿, 可迁移至山区道路边坡与库岸滑坡风险预警场景, 对滑坡防灾备考实用。

papers.title: 沙湾大沟泥石流冲击曲面导流设施动力过程研究
papers.abstractZh: 云南昆明寻甸沙湾大沟泥石流发育历史悠久、活动性强, 原有阶梯型导流槽磨蚀损毁严重几近失效。三期治理工程将导流槽底面设计为曲面跌水特殊形式, 实际运行效果良好。研究引入SPH-DEM-FEM耦合方法构建导流系统流固耦合模型, 分析泥石流冲击曲面导流设施的运动过程与动力响应, 并与阶梯型导流槽对比。结果表明: 冲击过程中导流槽右侧积聚和爬升现象明显, 左右两侧峰值速度分别为24.96、17.38 m/s, 坡度衔接段及出口水平段受冲击较大, 等效应力峰值722.3 kPa; 相同工程条件下曲面型导流槽对泥石流颗粒的减速消能效果更好, 使用寿命优于阶梯型, 为该类导流槽设计提供参考。
papers.abstractEn: The Shawan Dagou debris flow gully in Xundian, Kunming, Yunnan, has a long history of strong activity, and its original stepped drainage channel was severely worn and nearly failed. In the third-phase treatment, a curved-waterfall channel floor was proposed to reduce abrasion, and its field performance proved good. A fluid-structure interaction model of the drainage system is built using the coupled SPH-DEM-FEM method to analyze the impact process and dynamic response of debris flow on the curved facility, compared with the stepped channel. Results show obvious accumulation and run-up on the right side of the curved channel, with peak velocities of 24.96 and 17.38 m/s on the two sides; the slope-transition sections and the outlet segment experience the largest impact, with a peak equivalent stress of 722.3 kPa. Under the same conditions, the curved channel decelerates debris-flow particles and dissipates energy more effectively and offers a longer service life than the stepped channel, providing reference for the design of such drainage facilities.
papers.value: 泥石流导流设施SPH-DEM-FEM流固耦合动力模拟案例, 工程减灾措施设计思路清晰, 对泥石流防治工程方向备考很有实用价值。

papers.title: 山洪灾害全链条防控技术与防灾减灾模式探究
papers.abstractZh: 针对极端降雨条件下山洪灾害频发、传统防控适应性不足及现有研究碎片化等问题, 突破小流域精细化防控与跨主体协同短板, 构建监测-预警-防控-应急-复盘全链条技术体系: 整合多源数据研发微压电雨量计等高精度低功耗设备, 建立空天地一体化监测网络; 融合水文机理与机器学习建立动态预警模型及区域风险模型, 创新自然-社会二元防灾模式并提出分区适配应急处置方案, 在五大典型示范区验证。动态预警模型延长预见期20%以上, 洪峰流量预报精度提升至60%以上, 综合风险评估模型准确度超70%, 应急处置时效提高10%以上, 形成可复制的山丘区防灾范式。
papers.abstractEn: To address frequent flash floods under extreme rainfall, the limited adaptability of traditional prevention measures and the fragmentation of existing research, a full-chain system integrating monitoring, early warning, prevention and control, emergency response and review is established. Multi-source data are integrated to develop high-precision, low-power devices such as micro-piezoelectric rain gauges, building an integrated air-space-land monitoring network. Dynamic early warning and regional risk models are developed by coupling hydrological mechanisms with machine learning, and a nature-society dual disaster prevention model with zoned emergency response plans is proposed and verified in five typical demonstration areas. The dynamic early warning model extends the lead time by more than 20%, peak-flow forecast accuracy rises above 60%, the comprehensive risk assessment model achieves over 70% accuracy, and emergency response timeliness improves by more than 10%, forming a replicable disaster prevention paradigm for mountainous and hilly areas.
papers.value: 山洪灾害全链条防控体系集成监测、预警与应急复盘, 与极端暴雨主题呼应, 是山洪灾害防治备考的系统性综述素材。
